The signals at 7.46 ppm (4H) suggest an aromatic ring, and the signals at 0.85 ppm (3H) and 2.04 ppm (2H) suggest an alkyl group, possibly a propyl group. The signal at 4.62 ppm (1H) could be a vinyl proton.

I will now validate the SMILES strings of the isomers to find the one that matches these NMR characteristics.
